title: Open the Lock
statement: A lock has 4 circular wheels, each showing 0..9. It starts at '0000'. One move turns one wheel by one slot. `deadends` jam the lock if you reach them, including at the start. Return the minimum moves to reach `target`, or -1.
hints: This is an unweighted graph of 10000 nodes. BFS gives the shortest path.
Each node has 8 neighbors: each wheel up or down.
Put deadends in a set and treat them as removed nodes. If the start is dead, return -1.
editorial: BFS from 0000 with distance 0, skipping deadends. Generate a neighbor by adding or subtracting one on one digit, modulo 10. The first time the target is dequeued, or generated, its distance is optimal.
